About inquirED

inquirED was founded by teachers to bring rigorous and joyful learning to every student. We’re a fast-growing start-up, serving more educators and students every day. Inkwell, our integrated ELA and social studies curriculum, brings two core subjects studies together into one coherent instructional experience that builds knowledge and literacy skills, saves time and resources, and supports meaningful learning for both students and teachers. Inquiry Journeys, our elementary social studies curriculum, is used in schools and districts across the country to help students develop deep social studies knowledge and the inquiry skills essential for a thriving democracy. Join our team of designers, advocates, guides, thought leaders, and makers to help us make an even greater impact. Together, we can shape the future of education.

About the engagement

The Project:

We’re building an integrated K–5 Core ELA and social studies curriculum designed to meet the needs of diverse learners while making it easier for elementary teachers to meaningfully incorporate social studies without sacrificing literacy goals.

As part of this work, we're looking for part-time Curriculum Design Specialist Contractors to support the ongoing development and refinement of instructional materials. Contractors will work from existing lesson drafts, instructional frameworks, templates, and design guidance to develop and revise complete lessons and individual lesson components. Drawing on their grade-level expertise, they will strengthen standards alignment, student engagement, developmental appropriateness, and accessibility for diverse learners.

This engagement focuses on strengthening the clarity, coherence, and instructional quality of curriculum materials. Contractors will collaborate with our curriculum team to incorporate feedback, refine instructional activities, and ensure materials are standards-aligned, engaging, and consistent with inquirED's pedagogical vision.

Initial engagement Dec 2026 – March 2027, with potential extension based on project needs.

Ideal Candidate Profile:

In this contract, you'll collaborate with our curriculum team on a defined scope of deliverables focused on reviewing, revising, and refining elementary instructional materials.

You are someone who believes that high-quality curriculum should engage students in meaningful learning while building knowledge and literacy skills. You have a strong understanding of elementary instruction and can recognize what makes a lesson effective, developmentally appropriate, and accessible to diverse learners.

You are comfortable working within established curriculum frameworks and using provided models and guidance to revise instructional materials. You welcome feedback, ask thoughtful questions, and collaborate effectively with others to produce clear, engaging, classroom-ready materials.

Deliverables:

  • Develop and revise complete lessons and individual lesson components using existing drafts, instructional frameworks, templates, and design guidance.
  • Review lessons and instructional activities in development, providing actionable recommendations to strengthen standards alignment, student engagement, grade-level appropriateness, and accessibility for diverse learners.
  • Ensure instructional materials align with established learning goals, ELA and social studies standards, and unit learning progressions.
  • Apply established instructional strategies, pedagogical approaches, and design specifications to ensure materials are coherent, engaging, and consistent with inquirED's curriculum expectations.
  • Incorporate feedback from curriculum reviewers to improve the clarity, accuracy, and instructional quality of assigned materials.
  • Review and refine materials for completeness, consistency, and classroom usability before submission.
  • Complete assigned deliverables within established timelines, following team workflows and communicating progress, questions, or areas needing clarification as they arise.

Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of experience in elementary education, curriculum development, or instructional design, with K–5 classroom teaching experience strongly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of elementary instructional practices, including developmentally appropriate learning activities, student engagement strategies, and scaffolding for diverse learners.
  • Experience developing, reviewing, or revising high- quality instructional materials, including lessons, activities, and student-facing resources.
  • Strong knowledge of elementary ELA or social studies standards and the ability to apply provided standards and learning objectives to evaluate and revise instructional materials. Knowledge of standards in both content areas is preferred.
  • Experience working within established curriculum frameworks, instructional models, and design guidelines to develop or refine instructional materials.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to incorporate feedback to improve the accuracy, consistency, and instructional quality of materials.
  • Strong organizational and communication skills, with the ability to manage assigned deliverables, meet deadlines, and collaborate effectively with a remote team.

Tools You’ll Likely Use:

  • Google Suite and collaborative content development systems (e.g., Airtable)
  • AI content generation and editing platforms (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, in addition to potential proprietary internal tools)
  • Curriculum tagging systems and rubrics aligned to focus standards

Hourly rate for this engagement is $60/hour based on experience. Hours range expected from 10-15 hrs per week based on availability.

*Please note that because of high application volume, we are only able to respond to applicants moving forward in the process.

Must be U.S. based.

About JerseySTEM

All JerseySTEM roles are pro-bono (unpaid) positions.JerseySTEM is a mission-driven professional network of pro-bono contributors dedicated to improving access to STEM education and career pathways for underserved middle school girls in New Jersey.

Members contribute their professional skills and leverage their networks in service of the organization’s gender-equity agenda.Membership is a minimum six-month commitment of approximately six flexible hours per week and includes a $100 refundable deposit, returned after six months of active membership. K–12 educators, retirees, veterans, interns, and students are exempt from the deposit.

Overview

This is a pro-bono volunteer position.

JerseySTEM is seeking a Lab Sciences Team Member/Curriculum Designer to play a pivotal role in developing and enhancing our STEM education offerings for underrepresented middle school girls. As the Lab Sciences Team Member/Curriculum Designer, you will be creating engaging and hands-on lab sciences curriculum to inspire and educate young minds.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with subject matter experts and educators to design innovative lab-based activities.
  • Develop comprehensive curriculum modules that align with JerseySTEM's mission and educational goals.
  • Ensure that the lab sciences curriculum is age-appropriate and aligned with educational standards.
  • Integrate interactive and inquiry-based learning techniques into curriculum materials.
  • Review and improve existing lab sciences curriculum content for accuracy and effectiveness.
  • Provide guidance and support to curriculum team members, offering mentorship and training.
  • Collaborate with other curriculum teams to ensure interdisciplinary connections within programs.

Qualifications

Qualifications

  • Strong passion for STEM education and lab sciences.
  • Experience in curriculum design and development, particularly in lab sciences subjects.
  • Knowledge of educational standards and best practices.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.
  • Creativity in developing hands-on and engaging lab activities.
  • Leadership and mentoring skills to guide a team of curriculum developers.
  • Familiarity with digital tools for curriculum development.
  • Commitment to promoting gender equity in STEM education.

Time Commitment

  • 3-6 Hours weekly
  • 6 months minimum

About ACC

Australian Christian College (ACC) is a non-denominational, Christian Education organisation, whose mission is to develop each and every student to be equipped spiritually, academically, socially and physically to flourish into their full potential, and be a positive influence on the world around them. ACC is wholeheartedly committed to excellence in education so that students are “well known, well loved, and well taught” by dedicated trained Christian staff.

ACC is part of Christian Education Ministries (CEM), with 17 schools in 5 states, and is also the largest non-government Distance Education provider in Australia.

About ACC Victoria Online

ACC Victoria Online is located at our ACC Casey campus in Cranbourne South (45 minutes south of Melbourne) and delivers online schooling from Year 5-11 in 2026. For more information please visit our website

We’re praying for the right staff to come and join this growing team for the exciting opportunities in ACC.

Statement of Commitment to Child Safety & Wellbeing

  • ACC Victoria Ltd is a child safe organisation that welcomes all children, young people and their families.
  • We are committed to providing environments where our students are safe and feel safe, where their participation is valued, their views respected, and their voices are heard about decisions that affect their lives. Our child safe policies, strategies and practices are inclusive of the needs of all children and students.
  • We have no tolerance for child abuse and take proactive steps to identify and manage any risks of harm to students in our school environments.
  • We promote positive relationships between students and adults and between students and their peers. These relationships are based on trust and respect.
  • We take proactive steps to identify and manage any risk of harm to students in our school environment. When child safety concerns are raised or identified, we treat these seriously and respond promptly and thoroughly.
  • Particular attention is given to the child safety needs of Aboriginal students, those from culturally and linguistically diverse backgrounds, international students, students with disabilities, those unable to live at home, those who identify as LGBTIQ+, and all other students experiencing risk or vulnerability.
  • Inappropriate or harmful behaviour targeting students based on these or other characteristics, such as racism or homophobia, are not tolerated at our school, and any instances identified will be addressed with appropriate consequences.
  • Child safety is a shared responsibility. Every person involved in our school has an important role in promoting child safety and well-being and promptly raising any issues or concerns about a child’s safety.
  • We are committed to regularly reviewing our child-safe practices, and seeking input from our students, families, staff, and volunteers to inform our ongoing strategies.

As a part of your application, you must read and support the Child Safety & Wellbeing Policy and the Child Safety Code of Conduct.

Core Responsibilities & Duties

  • Plan and implement a range of teaching programs or courses of study;
  • Competent in the use of ICT learning platforms, in particular, Canvas;
  • Have the content knowledge and pedagogical practice to engage students in online learning
  • Demonstrate a commitment to improving professional practice through coaching and professional development
  • Provide a child-safe environment in accordance with the child-safe standards;
  • Participate in child safety and wellbeing induction and training provided by the school and always follow the school’s child safety and wellbeing policies and procedures;
  • Act in accordance with our Child Safety Code of Conduct;
  • Identify and raise concerns about child safety issues in accordance with our Child Safety Responding and Reporting Obligations Policy and Procedures, including following the Four Critical Actions for Schools;
  • Ensure students’ views are taken seriously and their voices are heard about decisions that affect their lives;
  • Model and promote the vision and values of the school;
  • Teach an area of the curriculum to senior year levels and develop online VCE courses for delivery;
  • Maintain records of class attendance and record student progress;
  • Implement effective student management consistent with the school’s strategic plan;
  • Attend and participate in staff meetings as required;
  • Be actively involved in regular staff devotions and prayer.

About the role

Applications are sought from suitably qualified and experienced VCE teachers and curriculum developers who are passionate about building high-quality online learning for senior secondary students.

The VCE Curriculum Content Builder will partner with ACC Victoria Online to design and develop VCE course content for online delivery. This project-based contractor role includes creating curriculum, learning and assessment materials that are compliant with VCAA requirements and suitable for use by senior secondary students in an online learning environment.

The successful applicant will be able to translate VCAA requirements into clear, engaging and well-structured online lessons that support students to learn independently while remaining well supported by teachers. The role requires strong curriculum judgement, careful organisation, confidence with digital learning tools, and a commitment to producing work that is accurate, consistent and ready for delivery.

Some work, including filming, may be required at our Casey campus in Cranbourne South or on ACC-approved devices and platforms.

The position involves work connected to children and young people. The appointment of successful applicants will be subject to satisfactory employment screening for identity, rights to work in Australia, and child protection in accordance with CEM policy.

Role Responsibilities:

  • Develop high-quality online curriculum for VCE Units, aligned with Victorian Curriculum and Assessment Authority (VCAA) subject specific study design and provided project build specifications.
  • Design clear, engaging learning materials that support students to understand key concepts, practise skills and prepare for assessment.
  • Apply strong subject knowledge and curriculum judgement to sequence learning appropriately across the relevant VCE Unit.
  • Create assessment and learning resources, including filmed lessons, that reflect the school’s VCE expectations and support consistent online delivery.
  • Use digital learning tools confidently to prepare and organise course materials, including Google Suite and Canvas where required.
  • Collaborate with ACC Victoria Online staff, responding to feedback and making revisions to ensure curriculum quality and consistency.
  • Manage agreed timelines and deliverables with a high level of organisation, accuracy and professional communication.
  • Model and promote the vision and values of the school, including a commitment to child safety, student wellbeing and confidentiality.

Requirements

Qualifications

  • Evidence of the right to work in Australia
  • Proof of identity
  • Recognised teaching qualification
  • Clearance status of the Working with Children Check (where applicable)
  • Registered with the Victorian Institute of Teaching (VIT)
  • Statements of service from previous child-connected roles
  • References from previous child-connected roles

You will:

  • Be a committed Christian, comfortable with sharing your faith
  • Be committed to improving student academic outcomes
  • Have high expectations for what students are capable of, both academically and behaviourally
  • Relate well to staff, students and parents.
  • Have a servant heart
  • Have demonstrated excellent organisational skills
  • Have strong knowledge of VCE curriculum, assessment and VCAA requirements in your subject area
  • Be confident in learning and using digital learning platforms, particularly Canvas and Google Suite

About you

  • Be able to display the capacity to improve student learning outcomes.
  • Be able to demonstrate excellent teaching and curriculum practice as described by the Australian Professional Standards for Teachers.
  • Be able to receive feedback on your course materials and implement changes.
  • Be able to effectively plan for, collect and use educational data and curriculum documentation to improve student learning.
  • Be able to design clear, coherent and engaging online lessons for senior secondary students.
  • Be able to meet agreed milestones and maintain accurate progress records throughout the project.

Benefits

  • Work within a team that has a clear Christian vision and a strong Christian culture.
  • Play an active part in growing ACC Victoria Online and providing quality Christian care to students.
  • Contribute to the development of high-quality online VCE courses for current and future students.
  • Flexible project-based contractor work, with clear deliverables and milestones.
  • The opportunity to be part of a growing senior secondary online learning team.

About the Mission
TerraByte Green is a non-profit startup based in North Carolina, focused on the intersection of digital equity and environmental sustainability. We manage e-waste responsibly by refurbishing technology to bridge the digital divide.

The Big Picture
This is a fully remote internship, though candidates based in North Carolina, especially those local to our operating area, are preferred. You will work directly with our Founder and CEO and closely with our Web Manager Intern to build out AI literacy curriculum for our LearnPress course platform. This is a hands on opportunity to build real instructional design experience in a growing field.

What You Will Do

  • Help create and structure AI literacy curriculum and course content

  • Work closely with the Web Manager Intern to get course material published on LearnPress

  • Research AI literacy frameworks and best practices to inform course design

  • Support the development of course materials, assessments, and learning activities

  • Help refine existing course content based on participant feedback

Why This Opportunity Matters

  • You get real, portfolio ready instructional design and curriculum development experience

  • You will have direct ownership over content that helps close the digital divide

  • You will build skills in curriculum design, AI literacy, and course platform management, all of which transfer directly to future roles

  • You will receive mentorship, a letter of recommendation or reference, and networking opportunities within the nonprofit and education space

  • Strong performance may lead to future paid opportunities as TerraByte Green grows

Compensation
This is an unpaid internship. Our priority is giving you real experience, mentorship, and professional material you can use to grow your career, with the goal of transitioning capable interns into paid roles as the organization's revenue grows.

Requirements & Onboarding

  • North Carolina residency preferred, open to fully remote candidates

  • Commitment of 5 to 10 hours per week for a 3 month internship

  • No prior curriculum design experience required. We are looking for reliability and curiosity over existing skill

  • Reports directly to the Founder and CEO

Internship Disclaimer
This is an unpaid volunteer internship with TerraByte Green, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization. There is no compensation, wage, or salary associated with this role, and no expectation of compensation, express or implied, is created by this posting or by any communication during the application or internship process. The internship is structured for the primary benefit of the intern, providing training, mentorship, and hands on experience comparable to what would be gained in an educational setting, rather than to fill a role that would otherwise be performed by paid staff. The internship duration is limited to the period defined at the start of the engagement (3 months), reflecting the period in which the intern receives meaningful educational and professional benefit. Acceptance of this internship does not create any express or implied entitlement to future paid employment with TerraByte Green, though capable interns may be considered for future paid roles as organizational funding allows. Applicants must be authorized to volunteer in the United States.

Mathspace is a cutting-edge eLearning platform, delivering enriching and personalised mathematics content to thousands of schools across the world.

Students are provided with step-by-step marking and assistance to ensure they receive the right help at the right time no matter how they choose to engage with a question. Our content is engaging and interactive, and the Mathspace system adapts to student proficiency while providing a wealth of data for educators to guide their students' growth to complete mastery.

We are embarking on an exciting project to develop comprehensive digital textbooks for the Victorian Curriculum K-6 Mathematics. We're seeking an experienced primary educator to lead this initiative on a 6 to 12-month remote contract, overseeing content creation and ensuring our materials meet the highest standards of curriculum alignment and pedagogical quality.

This is a unique opportunity for someone who combines deep expertise in the Victorian primary mathematics curriculum with a passion for leveraging modern tools (including AI) to transform how educational content is developed and delivered.

The role will involve:

  • Leading the development of K-6 mathematics textbook content aligned to the Victorian Curriculum from planning through to completion
  • Overseeing content creation workflows and coordinating with internal team members
  • Conducting thorough reviews of all content to ensure rigorous alignment with Victorian Curriculum content descriptions, achievement standards, and proficiency strands
  • Providing specific, actionable feedback that enables the internal team to make precise edits and maintain world-class quality standards
  • Championing the use of AI tools throughout the content development process to maximise productivity and quality
  • Continuously improving team processes and workflows by identifying opportunities to integrate new AI capabilities
  • Ensuring consistency in pedagogical approach, mathematical rigour, and developmental progression across all materials

Requirements

  • Extensive experience teaching primary mathematics (K-6) in Victorian schools
  • Deep understanding of the Victorian Curriculum: Mathematics, including content descriptions, achievement standards, and the proficiency strands (Understanding, Fluency, Problem Solving, Reasoning)
  • Familiarity with Victorian Curriculum 2.0 updates
  • Strong familiarity with current AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) and a genuine enthusiasm for using them to enhance productivity
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to provide clear, specific feedback on content
  • Strong organisational and communication skills
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment and meet deadlines
  • A collaborative and team-oriented approach

Nice to haves

  • Experience in project management, publishing, or educational content development
  • Familiarity with primary mathematics curricula in other Australian states (e.g. NSW Syllabus, Australian Curriculum)
  • Experience with digital learning platforms or ed-tech environments
  • Experience with LaTeX or mathematical typesetting
  • A basic understanding of coding

Benefits

  • Contribute to a world-class learning resource that is transforming the future of maths education worldwide
  • Fully remote role with flexible working hours
  • Shape the Victorian primary offering for a product used by hundreds of thousands of students globally
  • Work with a team that embraces innovation and cutting-edge technology

Location: 100% remote (within or outside the U.S.)

Classification: Full-time (30-40 hours/week)

Pay Range: $25.12 - $34.50/hour

Welcome to Miaplaza!

Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive homeschool curriculum platform where all students can be successful! Our K-8 platforms include Miacademy, Always Icecream, and Clever Dragons, and our 9-12 options include MiaPrep and MiaPrep Online High School. Our student base is rapidly growing, and we’re hiring for multiple positions across several departments! Our expansion stems from our commitment to providing exceptional educational content and our pursuit of new opportunities. 🚀

You can hear our CEO, Johannes Ziegler, discuss our company’s values and future!

How you’ll make an impact (position summary):

Curriculum Developers work closely with other subject-matter experts, our production team, and an instructional coach to produce immersive, engaging, and academically rigorous learning materials that constitute the core of our curriculum. These materials include videos, assessments, and written learning activities. Curriculum Developers are experts in their fields who thrive when wearing many hats. Our team relies on highly motivated, collaborative, and student-driven individuals.

What you’ll do (responsibilities):

  • Spend a majority of your time designing and developing ELA educational content (video scripts, assessments, and written materials) for 6-12th grade students

  • Ensure content is pedagogically sound, engaging, age-appropriate, and accessible for students

  • Write clear and measurable lesson objectives, and align teaching materials to meet objectives

  • Use technology, such as Google Slides, Sheets, Docs, and screencasting software

  • Differentiate instruction to accommodate diverse student populations and needs

  • Continuously evaluate and refine content based on feedback and educational outcomes

  • Collaborate with peers on curriculum development

  • Give and receive feedback on lessons, course development, and processes

Check out a day in the life of a Miaplaza Curriculum Developer!

Requirements

You may be a good fit if you have (requirements):

  • A minimum of 2 years of full-time ELA classroom teaching experience at the 9-12th grade levels (excluding student teaching, tutoring, and supplemental education).

  • A Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Education or in an ELA-related field

  • Familiarity with writing lesson objectives and creating objective-aligned lesson materials

  • Experience creating well-structured and effective lessons.

  • Ability to differentiate instruction to make learning accessible, engaging, and age-appropriate

  • Strong understanding of what makes a lesson engaging

  • Experience using technology to support instruction, including Google Slides, Sheets, and Docs

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, especially written

  • Growth mindset and motivated by constructive feedback

  • Proven ability to work independently, manage schedules, and meet deadlines

  • High motivation, a proactive attitude, and a tendency to seek opportunities for continuous improvement

  • High standards of integrity and transparency

  • Access to a computer/laptop (with camera) and a reliable high-speed internet connection

What makes you stand out (nice-to-haves):

  • You have an active teaching certification, and/or you have completed professional development or training in curriculum design and pedagogy

  • You have hands-on experience designing and writing curriculum, including writing scripts for completely asynchronous video lessons

  • You have experience teaching and designing lessons for SAT/ACT test prep, or AP courses such as AP English Language and Composition or AP Literature and Composition

  • You have experience analyzing and transforming data into actionable goals that have positively impacted your students

  • You have experience with screencasting software or online instruction

  • Your own unique talents! Your background has given you a unique perspective and set of skills that might not be listed here but may still be transferable to this role. If you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications outlined above, we still strongly encourage you to apply.

Compensation & benefits:

  • This is an hourly position that requires a minimum of 30 hours a week for full-time status. The expected starting pay range is $25.12 - $34.50 per hour. When working 40 hours per week year-round, this equates to an approximate annual pay range of $52,249–$71,760.

  • Miaplaza’s compensation philosophy ensures equity and competitiveness while considering the regional differences in living and labor costs. Specific rates will be provided during the hiring process and are aligned with market data and internal equity.

  • Compensation is evaluated twice per year. Employee compensation is determined by lesson quality, efficiency, and performance.

  • Full-time employees are eligible for health, dental, and vision insurance, inclusive of specialty care options like fertility benefits, mental health services, and chiropractic care, FSA, HSA, and more.

About the Role

We are looking for an IB Curriculum Content Project Manager to lead the creation and refinement of our International Baccalaureate (IB) mathematics textbooks for both the Middle Years Programme (MYP) and Diploma Programme (DP). In this 12-month contract role (fully remote), you will leverage your deep understanding of the IB curriculum to ensure our content is pedagogically sound, fully aligned with IB standards, and of the highest quality. You will project manage the end-to-end content development process, coordinating a team of writers and editors, planning content delivery, performing detailed reviews, and continually improving our workflow with the latest tech and AI tools.

This role is ideal for an experienced IB educator or curriculum developer who is also tech-savvy. You will play a critical part in shaping world-class IB math resources that empower teachers and students globally.

Responsibilities

  • Lead Content Development: Oversee the end-to-end creation of IB MYP & DP mathematics textbook content, from initial planning through final publication. Manage project timelines, set milestones, and ensure the content development stays on track.
  • Curriculum Alignment: Ensure all lessons, examples, and practice questions are tightly aligned with IB curriculum requirements and reflect the depth and breadth of the IB MYP and DP syllabi. The goal is to cover all required topics with appropriate rigor and IB-specific approaches (e.g. inquiry-based learning, real-world contexts).
  • Content Review & Quality Assurance: Conduct thorough reviews of content produced by the team (including lessons, questions, solutions, and explanatory materials). Provide detailed, specific feedback to authors on how to improve clarity, pedagogical effectiveness, and alignment. Your review comments will guide the internal team in making edits to meet our high standards of accuracy, clarity, and IB-style educational quality.
  • Team Coordination: Work closely with a team of content developers, educators, and editors. Facilitate collaboration and communication across the team, ensuring everyone understands the project goals and quality expectations. Mentor content writers in best practices for IB curriculum design.
  • Process Improvement & AI Integration: Continuously refine our content development and review processes to improve efficiency and quality. Be proactive in leveraging technology and AI tools (e.g. content generation and analysis tools) to aid in creating and reviewing materials. For example, use AI to help generate draft questions or check alignment, and integrate new tools to streamline workflows. Being comfortable with the latest ed-tech and AI tools is a must for maximizing productivity.
  • Final Quality Ownership: Before content is released, ensure that each unit/chapter meets a “world-class” quality standard: fact-checked, pedagogically sound, engaging for students, and polished in language and presentation. Ultimately, you are the guardian of quality for our IB math textbooks, ensuring that Mathspace’s IB offerings can serve as comprehensive stand-alone resources for schools .

Requirements

  • IB Curriculum Expertise: Extensive knowledge of the IB mathematics curriculum for MYP and DP. Ideally, at least a few years of experience teaching IB MYP and/or DP Mathematics, or experience in developing IB-aligned curriculum materials. You should be intimately familiar with IB objectives, assessment criteria, and the style of IB math problems.
  • Content Development Experience: Strong background in educational content creation – for example, writing or editing math textbook chapters, lesson plans, or exam-style questions. You understand how to scaffold concepts and design practice problems that build understanding.
  • Project Management Skills: Excellent organisational and project management abilities. Experience leading projects or teams in an education or publishing context is highly valued (e.g. managing a curriculum writing project or publishing a textbook). You can break down large tasks, meet deadlines, and coordinate others’ work effectively.
  • Tech Savvy & AI Proficiency: High comfort with technology and quick to adapt to new tools. Willingness to use and experiment with modern AI tools to enhance productivity and content quality is essential. You don’t need to be a programmer, but you should be eager to utilise software to work smarter. Experience with tools like LaTeX or other math authoring software is also beneficial .
  • Communication & Collaboration: Excellent communication skills – especially in writing clear, constructive feedback. Ability to work collaboratively in a remote team, coordinate meetings or discussions across time zones, and share knowledge with colleagues. You can articulate what makes good educational content and guide others to achieve it.
  • Detail Orientation and Quality Focus: Meticulous attention to detail when it comes to academic accuracy, formatting, and consistency. A passion for maintaining high quality standards. You care about the student learning experience and will insist on clarity and correctness in every piece of content.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Educational Publishing Experience: Prior experience in a curriculum publishing role or as an editor for math educational content. Familiarity with the processes of textbook publishing, such as peer review, copyediting, and layout considerations.
  • Assessment and Exam Insight: Experience writing or grading mathematics exams (for IB or other curricula) can be helpful, as it gives insight into exam-style question quality and common student pitfalls .
  • Coding/Tools: Basic experience with programming or data tools (e.g. Python or SQL) isn’t required but could be useful in working with our system or analysing content usage data . Similarly, experience using LaTeX for mathematical content formatting is an advantage.

Benefits

  • Remote Work & Flexibility: This role is fully remote – work from home with flexible hours. We value work-life balance and can accommodate flexible arrangements .
  • Collaborative, Impactful Culture: Join a relaxed, friendly team environment where your contributions directly impact teachers and students across the world . We foster creativity and teamwork, with the shared goal of improving math education globally.
  • Professional Growth: You’ll be at the forefront of integrating AI and innovative practices in education. This is an opportunity to lead a high-profile project and further develop leadership skills in curriculum development.
  • Mission-Driven Work: Be part of a mission to deliver better learning experiences. Your work will help shape a comprehensive IB math resource used by schools internationally, truly making a difference in classrooms.

If you are passionate about the IB curriculum and excited about harnessing technology to create outstanding educational content, we’d love to hear from you. Come help us shape the future of IB mathematics learning with Mathspace!

About the Role:

The Regional Training Lead plays a critical role in delivering a consistent, high-quality onboarding and training experience for Falcon Complete team within their assigned region. This mid-level role is responsible for managing regional training coordinators and team trainers, providing direct oversight of onboarding progression, ensuring timely training completion, and serving as the primary point of contact for all regional training needs.


You will work closely with Training & Onboarding (T&O) leadership and Curriculum Developers to maintain global alignment while tailoring training approaches to meet regional nuances. This includes providing follow-the-sun coverage for training platforms, supporting system administration within the region, and ensuring employees have real-time access to help and guidance.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in fast-paced, globally distributed environments, is highly organized, and is passionate about elevating employee readiness and performance. You’ll balance people leadership, operational ownership, and hands-on training support — all while strengthening the global Falcon Complete training ecosystem.

About the Team:


The Training & Onboarding team is dedicated to designing, delivering, and scaling world-class learning experiences for Falcon Complete analysts across the globe. We are a small, collaborative, and mission-focused team that partners closely with regional leadership, onboarding leads, Curriculum Developers, Service Assurance, and cross-functional stakeholders.

We work in a distributed, remote-first environment where trust, ownership, and communication are essential. As the regional extension of this global team, you will serve as the on-the-ground expert who ensures training consistency, regional visibility, and timely execution of onboarding and learning initiatives.

What You’ll Do:


  • Manage regional training coordinators and team trainers, ensuring alignment to Training & Onboarding processes, SOPs, and expectations.
  • Oversee onboarding and training for all new hires in your region, ensuring a consistent, high-quality experience and timely progression through required learning paths.
  • Support the ongoing maintenance and evolution of training content by updating materials as processes change, tracking content health, and ensuring onboarding reflects current tools, workflows, and best practices.
  • Provide real-time training and system support within the region, contributing to a follow-the-sun model for key platforms that Training and Onboarding use.
  • Partner with Curriculum Developers to support the creation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of training content, including contributing regional insights, assisting with content development, and ensuring materials remain accurate, relevant, and aligned to operational needs.
  • Monitor training data and metrics to identify knowledge gaps, regional trends, or performance challenges — and propose solutions or targeted interventions.
  • Support intake and prioritization of regional training needs, ensuring alignment with the broader training strategy and organizational roadmap.
  • Maintain close communication with regional leaders, onboarding leads, and cross-functional partners to ensure visibility into progress, challenges, and upcoming initiatives.
  • Ensure consistent adoption of T&O-owned onboarding standards and content within your region, while tailoring the delivery and operational execution to accommodate regional workflows and schedules.
  • Maintain documentation, JIRA tickets, and training records to support operational transparency and continuous improvement.
  • Deliver hands-on training or support facilitation on an as-needed basis.

What You’ll Need:


  • Experience in training, enablement, onboarding, or related operational roles.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage people and drive accountability across distributed teams.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to track training progression, monitor metrics, and identify areas of improvement.
  • Experience analyzing data to uncover deficiencies, trends, or readiness gaps — and articulating proposed solutions.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills across time zones and global teams.
  • Working knowledge of learning management systems such as Docebo (or equivalent LMS platform).
  • Experience working with Jira or similar project/workflow management tools.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and deliver results in a fast-moving environment.
  • Passion for improving employee onboarding, training experiences, and knowledge development.
  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

Bonus Points:


  • Experience creating or editing training content (e.g., Articulate 360, Rise, or similar authoring tools).
  • Prior experience delivering technical or cybersecurity-related training.
  • Experience supporting global teams or working in a follow-the-sun operational model.
  • Background in curriculum design, instructional design, or enablement strategy.
